newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close firmer, lag behind BTPs.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close firmer, lag behind BTPs.

text.p: Italian shares closed mostly firmer on Wednesday as optimism grew that agreement could be reached on an economic and monetary union stability pact but the market lagged behind bond futures which finished well up.
The all-share Mibtel index closed 0.65 percent higher at 12,213 with the blue chip Mib30 finishing 0.71 percent up at at 18,312. Turnover was more than 900 billion lire.

Brokers said that many foreign investors were standing on the sidelines and had expressed disappointment with the market's recent performance. "Investors don't seem to know where the market is going, they are very confused," said one broker.
Insurer Generali jumped 2.45 percent to close at 29,135 lire, boosted by late buying.
ENI closed 0.28 percent lower at 8,910 lire and is seen falling further when it goes ex-dividend later this month.
Parmalat rebounded, closing 1.24 percent up at 2,361 lire, after Canada said it would review the Italian company's bid for Ault Foods to determine whether it violated local competition laws.
